page.overview:
Who is Pocoloco Tripleseven?

Pocoloco appears as a bald man wearing a beanie with the words "HAPPY GO LUCKY" across the flipped-up edge. Much of his appearance is either similar or the same as his Steel Ball Run counterpart: his collar has the numbers "777" in bold lettering, his uniform has a graphic of a pierced target, and he has his signature horseshoe-shaped mustache and thick eyebrows.

In the novel, Pocoloco is an astronaut who is apart of the H.G. Wells spacecraft. He is accompanied by Funnier Valentine, Soundman, and Enrico Pucci on the ship. As the Eyed Balloon approaches them, he is shot by Valentine who plots to bring Kars back to Earth.

Right Stuff is Pocoloco's Stand. It allows Pocoloco to do simple tasks very quickly. He also uses it to fend off The Eyed Balloon near Mars.
